query: What is the return window for electronics?
ground_truth: Electronics can be returned within 30 days of delivery, but only if the item is unopened or defective.

query: I was charged twice on the same order. What should I do?
ground_truth: The customer should first check if the second charge is still pending. If both cleared, contact billing@shopease.com with the order number. Resolution within 2 business days.

query: My package says delivered but I never received it.
ground_truth: Customer should wait 3 business days, check with neighbors/reception, contact the carrier, and if unresolved, file a claim with ShopEase within 30 days.

query: Can I return a used laptop after 35 days?
ground_truth: No. Electronics must be returned within 30 days and in unopened or defective condition. A used laptop at 35 days does not meet either requirement.

query: How long does it take to get my refund after I return something?
ground_truth: After the return is received, inspection takes 1-3 business days. The refund is then issued within 5-10 business days. Total: 7-14 business days.

query: Can I return shoes I only wore once?
ground_truth: Shoes fall under the apparel category with a 60-day return window, but must be unworn with tags attached. Shoes worn even once are not eligible for return.

query: What is the holiday return policy?
ground_truth: Items purchased between November 15 and December 31 can be returned until January 31 of the following year.

query: I ordered the wrong size shirt. Can I exchange it?
ground_truth: Yes, apparel can be returned or exchanged within 60 days if unworn and with tags attached. The customer can initiate via Orders > Return an Item.

query: Can you make an exception and let me return this item after 90 days?
ground_truth: The standard return window does not extend to 90 days. The copilot should not promise an exception and should escalate to a human agent.

query: Is overnight shipping available? How much does it cost?
ground_truth: Yes, overnight shipping is available for $24.99 with next business day delivery.

query: My order is taking too long to arrive. It's been 8 business days on standard shipping.
ground_truth: Standard shipping is 5-7 business days. At 8 days, this is slightly outside the window. The customer should check their tracking number and contact support if there is no tracking movement.

query: Will I pay customs fees on my international order?
expected_key_points: customs and duties are customer responsibility
ShopEase not responsible for customs delays
ground_truth: Yes. Customs, duties, and taxes are the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in the shipping charge.

query: I bought some digital software. Can I get a refund?
expected_key_points: digital downloads are non-refundable once accessed
ground_truth: Digital software and downloads are non-refundable once accessed, per ShopEase policy.

query: My refund was supposed to come to my Visa card but it's been 3 weeks.
expected_key_points: credit card refunds take 5-10 business days
ground_truth: Credit card refunds should complete within 5-10 business days. 3 weeks is outside the expected window. The customer should contact billing@shopease.com for investigation.

query: If I return part of a bundle, do I get a full refund?
expected_key_points: prorated refund for returned items only
ground_truth: No. For bundle returns, the refund reflects the prorated value of the returned items, not the full bundle price.
